note: Global top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, navigation links (Issues, Merge Requests, To-Do List, Help), and user avatar; search input is subtracted as it may contain user-typed queries

Project sidebar navigation -- renders: fixed section labels (Information, Repository, Issues, Merge Requests, Pipelines, Deployments, etc.); the project name header is subtracted as it is a user-created name

Breadcrumbs -- renders: navigation path segments (namespace, project, section); while these are user-named, the breadcrumb widget is standard platform chrome and the segments are structural navigation rather than content bodies
Issue state tabs -- renders: fixed state labels (Open, Closed, All) with counts; the tab labels are operator vocabulary

Issue list toolbar -- renders: fixed action buttons (New Issue, Filter, Sort) and search controls; the issue list, tabs, and bulk update sidebar are subtracted as they contain user-generated content or dynamic lists
